title: Investigating potential prognostic genes and candidate therapeutic targets for acute myeloid leukemia in food-medicine homologous plants via integrated network pharmacology and transcriptomics.
authors: Tang, Mingxia; Chen, Tao; Huang, Tao; Bai, Shanshan; Wang, Yajiang; Zhang, Yanling; Yan, Lian; He, Xia
one_liner_zh: 该文通过网络药理学和转录组学筛选AML预后基因，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是药物靶点与疾病预后，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制研究。
abstract: Acute myeloid leukemia (AML) is a hematologic malignancy. Conventional chemotherapy often causes substantial adverse effects, while food-medicine homologous plants with favorable safety profiles and multitarget regulatory activities offer a promising strategy for AML treatment. This study aimed to screen core bioactive compounds from 106 food-medicine homologous plants, identify potential prognostic genes related to AML, and explore the molecular mechanisms of their anti-AML activities. Public omics cohorts for AML were systematically analyzed to screen differentially expressed genes (DEGs). The DEGs were intersected with the target genes of 106 food-medicine homologous plants to obtain candidate genes for subsequent GO/KEGG functional enrichment analysis and PPI network analysis. Core bioactive compounds were screened and prioritized via the Graph-based Bilinear Attention Network (GraphBAN) combined with druggability and toxicology screening criteria. Potential prognostic genes were identified via univariate Cox proportional hazards regression analysis and further screening. Immune infiltration analysis and gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) were performed on the identified potential prognostic genes. Bioinformatic prediction was conducted to identify upstream transcription factors (TFs) and microRNAs (miRNAs) targeting these genes and to analyze their chromosomal distribution and subcellular localization characteristics. Binding affinity and stability between core active compounds and proteins encoded by potential prognostic genes were systematically confirmed by molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation analyses. The expression levels of potential prognostic genes were finally validated via reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR). We identified 1102 candidate genes, 542 core bioactive compounds, and 6 potential prognostic genes. The constructed prognostic model demonstrated moderate predictive performance. Immune infiltration analysis identified 18 types of differentially infiltrated immune-cell populations (P < 0.05), and GSEA results indicated that immunity-related signaling pathways were enriched in the AML high-risk subgroup. Moreover, 138 chemotherapeutic agents were identified. MYB-centered transcription factors and numerous microRNAs were found to regulate these potential prognostic genes. The genes reside on distinct chromosomes; for example, ITGB3 is located on chromosome 17. Further subcellular localization analysis revealed distinct protein distribution patterns. IGF1R, ITGB3, and SLC38A1 are predominantly located on the cell membrane, while KYNU, PDE4A, and GSTM2 are mostly located in the cytoplasm. Molecular docking revealed that the binding energy between IGF1R and MOL008397 was - 10.7 kcal/mol. Molecular dynamics simulation further confirmed the stability of this molecular complex. RT-qPCR verified distinct expression of the six prognostic genes in clinical AML blood samples. This study identified core active compounds and potential prognostic genes against AML derived from food-medicine homologous plants, which provides evidence for prognosis evaluation and targeted therapy.
abstract_zh: 急性髓系白血病（AML）是一种血液系统恶性肿瘤。常规化疗常引起显著的不良反应，而药食同源植物因其良好的安全性和多靶点调控活性，为AML治疗提供了一种有前景的策略。本研究旨在从106种药食同源植物中筛选核心生物活性化合物，识别与AML相关的潜在预后基因，并探讨其抗AML活性的分子机制。系统分析了AML的公共组学队列，以筛选差异表达基因（DEGs）。将DEGs与106种药食同源植物的靶基因取交集，获得候选基因，用于后续GO/KEGG功能富集分析和PPI网络分析。通过基于图的双线性注意力网络（GraphBAN）结合可成药性和毒理学筛选标准，筛选并优先排序核心生物活性化合物。通过单变量Cox比例风险回归分析及进一步筛选，识别潜在预后基因。对识别的潜在预后基因进行了免疫浸润分析和基因集富集分析（GSEA）。通过生物信息学预测，识别靶向这些基因的上游转录因子（TFs）和微小RNA（miRNAs），并分析其染色体分布和亚细胞定位特征。通过分子对接和分子动力学模拟分析，系统确认了核心活性化合物与潜在预后基因编码蛋白之间的结合亲和力和稳定性。最终通过逆转录定量聚合酶链反应（RT-qPCR）验证了潜在预后基因的表达水平。我们识别出1102个候选基因、542种核心生物活性化合物和6个潜在预后基因。构建的预后模型显示出中等预测性能。免疫浸润分析识别出18种差异浸润的免疫细胞群体（P < 0.05），GSEA结果表明，免疫相关信号通路在AML高风险亚组中富集。此外，识别出138种化疗药物。发现以MYB为中心的转录因子和众多微小RNA调控这些潜在预后基因。这些基因位于不同染色体上；例如，ITGB3位于17号染色体。进一步的亚细胞定位分析揭示了不同的蛋白质分布模式。IGF1R、ITGB3和SLC38A1主要位于细胞膜上，而KYNU、PDE4A和GSTM2主要位于细胞质中。分子对接显示，IGF1R与MOL008397之间的结合能为-10.7 kcal/mol。分子动力学模拟进一步确认了该分子复合物的稳定性。RT-qPCR验证了六个预后基因在临床AML血液样本中的差异表达。本研究识别了源自药食同源植物的抗AML核心活性化合物和潜在预后基因，为预后评估和靶向治疗提供了证据。
